title: Luxurious Glam Shell -  10 mins to Grand Ole Opry
description:
This memorable place is anything but ordinary.  The exterior metal "shell" of our dome is  called a Quonset Hut.  A Quonset hut is a tough, and durable structure but once inside this shell, you'll find a glamorous space decorated with furniture from bygone eras mixed  with new decor. Unique touches include a spiral staircase wrapped in roses, a luxurious freestanding bathtub with a TV above, gleaming brass sinks, a vintage hot pink sofa and  multiple elegant chandeliers.
